decree.d1: Odin decrees: those who fell in battle with a weapon in hand go to Valhalla. Everyone else goes to Hel.
decree.d2: Odin decrees: a wound in the back means they fled, and the fled go to Hel. You may now turn the bodies over.
decree.d3: Odin decrees: some of the fallen are only mostly dead. If the feather stirs, stamp RETURN.
shop.meadHorn.text: A little mead loosens dead tongues. Questioning costs 15 seconds of sun.
shop.oiledBier.text: The bier turns at a touch. Turning a body over costs 1 second.
shop.swanFeather.text: Light enough to stir at a whisper. The feather costs 6 seconds.
ending.demoted.title: Demoted
ending.demoted.text: Two nights deep in debt, and Odin's quartermaster takes your wings. You'll count shields in the armoury until Ragnarök.
ending.alone.title: An empty house
ending.alone.text: No one is left at home to write to. You judge the dead, and no one waits for you.
ending.demoEnd.title: The demo ends here
ending.demoEnd.text: Three days at the gate. Freyja is coming, the sea is rising, and Ragnarök is seventeen days away. The full game continues the story.
case.thorvald1.hall: Is this Valhalla? I thought it would be taller.
case.thorvald1.luck: They call me Thorvald the Unlucky. I've never understood why.
case.thorvald1.warm: Funny. Everyone here looks cold, and I feel fine.
coach.d1.look: A soul has reached your gate. Look them over: start with the hands.
coach.d1.chest: Now the chest. Wounds on the front mean they faced the fight.
coach.d1.rules: The Order of Judgment decides. Rules apply from the top, and the first one that fits wins.
coach.d1.stamp: Weapon in hand when they fell: Valhalla. Choose the stamp, then send it. The sun is running.
coach.d2.flip: New today: you can turn a body over. Do it: the back tells you whether they ran.
coach.d2.back: Look at the back. A wound there means they fled.
coach.d2.compare: They say something the body denies. Catch the lie: tap what they say, then the wound.
coach.d2.stamp: The fled go to Hel, whatever they tell you. Stamp HEL.
coach.d3.face: Look at the face. A mist at the lips is a hint, not proof.
coach.d3.feather: New today: the feather. Hold it to the lips to be sure. It costs 10 seconds of sun.
coach.d3.stamp: The feather stirs: this one still breathes. The living go back. Stamp RETURN.
twist.liars: Word has gone round that the chooser is new. This round the dead lie to you more readily.
twist.beds: A fever went through the camps. Many of this round's dead died in their beds.
twist.battle: A great battle at the fjord. Many of this round's dead fell fighting.
twist.mist: A cold morning: breath hangs at the lips of the dead as well as the living. Trust the feather.
